title: Variation bound for face densities: ∫_{Q₁} u_F div g ≤ M_{W_F}(∂Q) with Σ_F M_{W_F}(∂Q) ≤ M(∂Q) (Simon Ch. 6, (28) second part; step 4 of the parent proof)
statement: Conventions (as in the selected node): ℝ^P = Euclid P, ℝⁿ = Euclid n, Hᵈ = μHE[d], e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 ∈ ℝ^P, x_i the i-th coordinate. n := m + 1. For a pair p = (z, ι) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P): Φ_p(y) := z + Σ_{j<n} y_j e_{ι(j)} for y ∈ ℝⁿ (Lean: WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)); e_p := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}); Q₁ := {y ∈ ℝⁿ : 0 < y_i < 1 for all i} with Lebesgue measure (volume); F_p := {x ∈ ℝ^P : z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for i ∈ range ι, x_i = z_i for i ∉ range ι} (the closed unit face of the selected node's statement); A_p := Φ_p(Q₁) (the open face). 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d (domain univ throughout); ∂X = X.boundary; M_W(X) = X.massOn W and M(X) = X.mass (Euclidean coefficient norm covectorEuclideanNorm); IMRep and IsIntegerMultiplicity are the contract notions. Statement: let P, m ∈ ℕ, s a finite set of pairs p = (z, ι) with every ι strictly increasing, u_p : ℝⁿ → ℝ arbitrary functions (p a pair), and Q ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with Q(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} u_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(e_p) dy for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) and M(∂Q) ≠ ∞. Then there are reals V_p (p a pair) with V_p ≥ 0 for p ∈ s and ENNReal.ofReal(Σ_{p∈s} V_p) ≤ M(∂Q), such that ∫_{Q₁} u_p(y)·trace(Dg(y)) dy ≤ V_p for every p ∈ s and every smooth (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) map g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ Q₁ and |g(y)| ≤ 1 for all y (trace(Dg(y)) = LinearMap.trace of fderiv ℝ g y = div g(y)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P))) (u : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.2) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Q ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))) → Q.boundary.mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ V : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ s, 0 ≤ V p) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, V p) ≤ Q.boundary.mass ∧ ∀ p ∈ s, ∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V p
